description: This script provides utility functions for managing software bundles, including version sorting, retrieving package metadata, validating bundle contents, and extracting bundle files. It contains functions to identify the oldest and latest versions, list installed versions, and perform sanity checks on bundle completeness.

methods.name: sortVersions
methods.description: Sorts a list of version strings in ascending order using a temporary directory and ls -v.

methods.name: getOldestVersion
methods.description: Returns the oldest version from a list of version strings.

methods.name: getLatestVersion
methods.description: Returns the latest version from a list of version strings.

methods.name: getInstalledVersions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of installed versions from given metadata files.

methods.name: getPkgMetadata
methods.description: Fetches package metadata value for a given JSON file and key using jsonquery.

methods.name: getInstalledPackages
methods.description: List installed packages by scanning directories and metadata files.

methods.name: sanityCheckBundle
methods.description: Checks for the presence of required files in a bundle directory to validate its integrity.

methods.name: extractBundle
methods.description: Extracts a bundle tar file to a specified destination directory.
